    # Count balls faced by counting rows per batsman (count of deliveries faced)
    'overs': 'count'  # temporarily use 'overs' column to count balls faced
}).rename(columns={'overs': 'balls_faced'}).reset_index()

    overs_part = balls // 6
    balls_part = balls % 6
    return overs_part + balls_part / 10
